benchsh-help.stdout:
usage: strata_bench.py [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--url URL] [--port PORT]
                       [--gpu GPU] [--api-key API_KEY] [--runs RUNS]
                       [--clients N] [--long] [--think] [--out OUT]
                       [--compare DIR] [--compare-only NEW]
                       [--ready-timeout READY_TIMEOUT] [--quiet]

Measure this Strata install and write a shareable report (see the top of this
file).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       the model config to run (default: the newest
                        strata-*.json of this folder)
  --url URL             use the server already running at this address
                        (http://127.0.0.1:8080) instead of starting one
  --port PORT           the port to start the server on (default: the
                        config's)
  --gpu GPU             start the server on this GPU only (as the server's
                        --gpu)
  --api-key API_KEY     the server's API key, if it has one (or STRATA_KEY)
  --runs RUNS           runs per test (default 3)
  --clients N           also send N requests at once
  --long                also a prompt of about 32,768 tokens
  --think               leave thinking on (the default suite turns it off)
  --out OUT             where to write the results folder (default:
                        bench/results)
  --compare DIR         a results folder (or its results.json) to put beside
                        this run
  --compare-only NEW    print --compare of two existing results folders and
                        stop
  --ready-timeout READY_TIMEOUT
                        seconds to wait for the model to load
  --quiet

server-help.stdout:
usage: server.py [-h] [--engine {mock,strata}] [--config CONFIG] [--host HOST]
                 [--script SCRIPT] [--port PORT] [--gpu GPU]
                 [--tokenizer TOKENIZER] [--open] [--fit-max-tokens]
                 [--vision-onednn {on,off}] [--api-key API_KEY]
                 [--mcp-config MCP_CONFIG] [--lazy] [--api-monitor]
                 [--idle-unload SECONDS]
                 [--min-free-vram-mib MIN_FREE_VRAM_MIB]
                 [--before-load BEFORE_LOAD] [--slot-save-path DIR]
                 [--replicas N]

serve/server.py - plan v0.3 P8: OpenAI and Anthropic endpoints over any engine that maps token ids to tokens.

    python -m serve.server --engine mock --port 8095            (a scripted engine, for clients and tests)
    python -m serve.server --engine strata --config strata.json --port 8095   (the real engine, resident)

Endpoints: POST /v1/chat/completions (OpenAI, stream and non-stream), POST /v1/messages (Anthropic, stream and
non-stream), GET /v1/models, GET /models, GET /props, GET /slots, GET /health, GET /mcp. One sequence at a time behind a FIFO (plan: one resident sequence).
Tools from MCP servers (serve/mcp.py, `"mcp_servers"` in the config or --mcp-config) are offered only to requests that
ask for them with `"strata_mcp": true` - the web app does; other clients see exactly the API they always saw.
Images (optional, when the config has a "vision" entry): OpenAI image_url parts and Anthropic image blocks (base64
data, http(s) URLs or local file paths) go through `strata-vision` (the model's mmproj file) and reach the engine as
embeddings (`GENI`).  JPEG/PNG/BMP/GIF go straight in; WebP, TIFF, AVIF, ... (agents like omp send WebP) are
converted to PNG first with Pillow.
Requests whose prompt plus max tokens exceed the engine's context are REJECTED with 400, never truncated.
An unset (or 0, or -1) max tokens means "unlimited": whatever the prompt leaves of the context.

The engine boundary is `Engine.generate(prompt_ids, max_new, sampling, cancel) -> iterator of token ids`.
`StrataEngine` keeps one `strata --serve` process resident (weights, expert arena and VRAM tier load once) and
talks to it over stdin/stdout; `MockEngine` is a scripted stand-in that makes every API path testable without a GPU.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --engine {mock,strata}
  --config CONFIG       strata engine config (JSON: exe, args, cwd, tokenizer,
                        model_name), written by setup.py
  --host HOST           the address to listen on: 127.0.0.1 = this PC only
                        (the default), 0.0.0.0 = also other devices on your
                        network (set an API key); also "host" in the config
  --script SCRIPT       the mock engine's answer (default: a short greeting);
                        given more than once, requests get them in turn and
                        the last one repeats
  --port PORT
  --gpu GPU             the GPU to run on, as nvidia-smi numbers them, or
                        several for a layer split ("0,2"; also "gpu" in the
                        config)
  --tokenizer TOKENIZER
                        pack tokenizer directory (falls back to a byte
                        tokenizer if absent)
  --open                open the local page in the browser once the model is
                        ready
  --fit-max-tokens      clamp max_tokens to the remaining context instead of
                        rejecting the request (default: reject with 400, like
                        llama.cpp; also "fit_max_tokens": true in the config)
  --vision-onednn {on,off}
                        the SYCL image encoder with oneDNN (a little faster;
                        an image's embeddings vary slightly from run to run)
                        or without; default: the config's "onednn" (setup:
                        off)
  --api-key API_KEY     require this key on /v1/* (Authorization: Bearer ...
                        or x-api-key); also $STRATA_API_KEY
  --mcp-config MCP_CONFIG
                        a JSON file with MCP servers in Claude Desktop's
                        format ({"mcpServers": {...}}); the web app's chat can
                        use their tools (also "mcp_servers" in the config)
  --lazy                start the API unloaded (the engine and the vision
                        encoder start with the first request)
  --api-monitor         the API request monitor at /api-monitor: keeps the
                        last 100 requests' prompts and answers in memory (also
                        "api_monitor": true in the config; off by default)
  --idle-unload SECONDS
                        unload the model after this many seconds without
                        requests, so other programs (games, other model
                        servers) can use the VRAM; the next request loads it
                        again (also "idle_unload_s" in the config; default:
                        never)
  --min-free-vram-mib MIN_FREE_VRAM_MIB
                        load an unloaded model only when this much VRAM is
                        free, else answer 503 (also "min_free_vram_mib" in the
                        config; default: always load)
  --before-load BEFORE_LOAD
                        a command run before the model is loaded again (e.g.
                        to unload another server's model; also "before_load"
                        in the config, a string or a list)
  --slot-save-path DIR  enable POST /slots/0?action=save|restore {"filename":
                        NAME} (llama-server's API): the conversation the
                        engine holds, to or from DIR/NAME (also
                        "slot_save_path" in the config)
  --replicas N          opt-in independent engines on N disjoint PCI groups;
                        requires replica RAM/VRAM reservations

comparison_policy: Only actual long-prompt rows for main ranking; phase metrics/repeats and every failure retained; no text equality quality gate
environment_setup: Ignored real .venv directory reuses existing interpreter/libraries; upstream source unchanged
